title: curation stage-umi --json (schema 1.0)
description: A raw UMI / TRUMI session (dataset_plan.pkl + demos/) made into a LeRobot v2.1 dataset with its trajectory.json in a local directory; the camera calibration is read from the session (design doc 24 §4-§5). The source is only read.

intrinsics.description: per camera: the session file the intrinsics were read from, or the built-in calibration

downloaded_bytes.description: bytes copied from a remote session (0 for a local one)
